mutationTesting.summary: 4/4 injected bugs caught, each by the intended property. This is the evidence that the 9 PASSes are non-vacuous and discriminating. All mutants restored; every restore verified byte-identical to lib/ HEAD.
mutationTesting.note: These FAIL/counterexample results are HARNESS VALIDATION, deliberately induced by this agent. They are NOT findings and must never be reported as bugs in story-031.

nonVacuityEvidence: Concrete tripwire: pendingPhUSD after setUp = 8219178081216000 wei (> 0), so `vm.assume(earned > 0)` does not kill all paths (test/halmos/Vacuity.t.sol, forge PASS).

Halmos prints an explicit 'all paths have been reverted' WARNING for vacuous tests — it fired for check_B3 under MUT-3, and did NOT fire for any clean run. Independent confirmation the clean PASSes are non-vacuous.
MUT-1 counterexamples at mintFails=0x00 AND 0x01 prove both mint branches are genuinely reachable and asserted.
limitations: SCOPE: only the phUSD leg is proven. The stable leg (_tryTransfer bank) and the promo leg are NOT covered by this suite.

MULTI-USER: INV-BANK-SUM is proven on real bytecode for a SINGLE staker only (B2/C2). The multi-user sum is proven at model level for TWO users (A3). A general N-user sum on real bytecode is NOT proven.

TIER A FIDELITY: Tier A is a hand transcription of :900-919 + the realignment. A PASS proves the ALGEBRA is sound; it is only as good as the transcription's fidelity to source. Tier B/C cover this gap by running real bytecode.

TIER B/C STATE COVERAGE: pool state is single-staker with APY=1000bps and no promo/stable stream armed. Interleavings with beginFlush/batchClaim, migrator-delegated beneficiaries (beneficiary != user), and multi-staker accrual are NOT symbolically covered.
BOUNDS ARE REAL: every PASS above is a proof UNDER ITS STATED DOMAIN only, not a general proof over full uint256.
BUILD CONFIG: legacy codegen (via_ir=false). Not evidence about a via_ir build.
conclusion: INV-NO-DOUBLE-PAY held under every configuration attempted, including on real PhlimboV3 bytecode with symbolic stake size, symbolic elapsed time and a symbolic mint outcome (check_C1). No counterexample was found on clean source. Zero timeouts, zero errors. The 4/4 mutation kill rate establishes the suite discriminates rather than passing vacuously. This corroborates the fuzz campaign's 0-counterexample result and upgrades it from sampling to proof-under-bound for the phUSD leg.
